did: Tested live in the browser pane by hand on the owner's Market screen, with a listing a seller had sent in (Braided USB-C cable). The owner set a commission and published it, then changed the commission, then switched off showing the seller's own name. The buyer's page was read after each.

checks.text: Waiting to be read: each listing shows the words, the seller's price, delivery and a warning when there is no photo, with a commission (percent or taka) and two answers: Publish, or Turn down with a reason the seller is told
Publish with 3 percent: the listing went live and the buyer saw 463.50 (the seller's 450 plus the 3 percent)
On the Published list the commission can be changed with Save: at 5 percent the buyer saw 472.50
"Show this seller's own name instead of ours" can be switched off for each listing: after it was, the buyer's page said Sold by Siam's Aqua
Each sector also has its own Open and settings (seen on the sector rows)

notes: Done by hand in the live browser. Turn down with a reason and the commission requests from sellers were not used in this run (only one listing was waiting and none was asking), so not every option was tried and this stays partly shown. The listing was left published at 5 percent.

shots.caption: A listing waiting to be read: commission, Publish, Turn down
